correctedPepHrm015ClientTransport.requestBody: The v1 six-field exact body remains unchanged: objectRef, objectDigest, schemaKey, schemaVersion, mode and effectiveDate; unknown fields reject.
correctedPepHrm015ClientTransport.purposeHeaderRule: X-Purpose-Code is optional transport. If present it must occur exactly once and equal HRIS_INTEGRATION byte-for-byte; blank, duplicate or any other value rejects before controller as closed-schema syntax only. Its absence does not establish purpose. The trusted fixed-purpose authorization decision always occurs after receipt reserve/hash in Auth.
correctedPepHrm015ClientTransport.opaqueChallengeHeaderRule: X-DWP-Step-Up-Challenge is optional transport so a missing, blank or semantically or cryptographically malformed challenge cannot be rejected before the receipt boundary. If present it must occur exactly once and satisfy only generic transport safety: at most 8192 bytes with no control or comma-folding characters. Gateway copies its raw value as an opaque reference without trimming, parsing or validating challenge meaning. A usable challenge is required for the later Auth verification to return ALLOWED; missing, blank, malformed, stale or wrong-target evidence is denied only after receipt/hash.
forbiddenHeaders: caller population or scope authority headers
caller field-policy or field-decision authority headers
caller authorization or feature revision headers
correctedPepHrm015ClientTransport.versionRule: If-Match is the sole client object-version transport. Missing, weak, malformed or duplicate If-Match rejects under closed transport; no other expected-version header is accepted or reconciled.
correctedPepHrm015ClientTransport.cardinalityRule: Every required or present optional header is exactly one value. Comma folding, conflicting case variants, duplicate values, surrounding whitespace and CR/LF reject.
correctedPepHrm015ClientTransport.gatewayTransformation: Gateway consumes the optional X-DWP-Step-Up-Challenge only as opaque input to the Auth marker request, strips it and every forbidden authority header, preserves Authorization, Idempotency-Key, If-Match and X-Correlation-ID, preserves syntactically valid optional X-Purpose-Code, and forwards only the Auth-signed owner-receipt marker.

exactException.scope: This is the only route allowed to defer target-bound step-up, exact narrow capability, duty and purpose decisions until after durable receipt reserve-or-read and canonical hash comparison. Every other route retains its existing pre-controller decision order and behavior.

require exactly POST and the exact HRM-012 ACTION route; wrong method, near-match path, trailing path, unknown route or wrong service binding denies

validate the complete corrected PEP-HRM-015 client header set and cardinality; treat a present exact HRIS_INTEGRATION purpose only as transport syntax and the optional X-DWP-Step-Up-Challenge only as opaque marker input
require exactly APP.HCM:VIEW or the registered same-product APP.HRIS:VIEW compatibility alias; absence of both, an implied entitlement, an unregistered alias or a wrong-product alias denies

require the HRIS_HRM_DATA_QUALITY_WORKBENCH feature decision to be enabled for this trusted tenant; baseline OFF, missing enrollment, inactive enrollment, missing activation, stale decision or decision unavailable denies before controller entry

strip or reject caller-supplied marker, tenant, subject, route, population, field and revision authority headers; consume then strip the opaque challenge while preserving a syntactically valid optional X-Purpose-Code without treating it as trusted purpose authority

issue and verify signed OWNER_RECEIPT_AUTH_REQUIRED evidence bound to trusted tenant, on-behalf-of subject, exact route, method, app-entitlement decision, feature decision revision, correlation ID and expiry
preControllerForbiddenChecksForExactExce: artifact, payload, mapping, run, item or cursor access

exactMarkerFlow.authEvaluateRequestExtension: ProductSurfaceAuthorityDtos.EvaluateRequest adds nullable correlationId, idempotencyKeySha256, opaqueStepUpChallengeRef, commandMethod and commandPath. They may be non-null only for the exact HRM-012 ACTION; every other route rejects them. Gateway supplies trusted correlation and the SHA-256 of the exact raw Idempotency-Key, and treats the client challenge as opaque.
exactMarkerFlow.authAuthorityResultExtension: ProductSurfaceAuthorityDtos.AuthorityResult adds nullable ownerReceiptAuthority. It is non-null only with state OWNER_RECEIPT_AUTH_REQUIRED after trusted identity, accepted app entitlement, exact route/method and enabled feature pass for this exact ACTION. It is null for every other route and never coexists with an ALLOWED command decision.
exactMarkerFlow.gatewayPropagation: ProductSurfaceContextDtos, ProductSurfaceAuthorityClient and ProductSurfaceContextAggregationService preserve the marker byte-for-byte. ProductSurfaceDecisionContextFilter removes caller challenge/marker and authority headers, sends the exact extension fields to Auth, and forwards exactly one returned X-DWP-HRM012-Owner-Receipt-Authority marker to People.
exactMarkerFlow.peopleEarlyBranch: HcmProductSurfacePepFilter has one exact early HRM-012 POST branch. It keeps trusted identity, accepted app and enabled-feature checks, verifies the marker with the shared contract verifier, and admits only an Hrm012OwnerReceiptAuthorityContext. It bypasses only the normal pre-controller capability and scope decision for this route, creates no HcmPepContext authority claim and cannot authorize metadata or business access.
exactMarkerFlow.otherRoutes: All other Gateway and People filter paths reject ownerReceiptAuthority input and preserve existing capability, scope, purpose, step-up and HcmPepContext behavior.

wire.cardinality: exactly one compact JWS; comma-folded, duplicate, blank or whitespace-altered values deny

protectedHeader.kid: required exact configured key identifier; embedded jwk, jku, x5u, crit and unknown protected fields deny

canonicalClaimValues.accepted_app_entitlement: enum APP.HCM:VIEW or APP.HRIS:VIEW; when both are present Auth writes canonical APP.HCM:VIEW

keySourceAndRotation.rule: Auth signs only with the active private key from the configured non-source secret/key provider. This slice permits People to verify only the single exact current kid/public key; previous-key overlap and automatic key discovery are not authorized. Rotation is an atomic configuration replacement coordinated outside this slice. Unknown kid, missing current key, a second accepted key, algorithm drift or fail-open key lookup denies. Key material, opaque challenge content and signatures never enter logs.

timeAndReplay.preReceiptRule: Before receipt reserve-or-read, the shared verifier checks only compact-JWS structure, protected-header exactness, signature, canonical claim schema, issuer, audience, time bounds and equality to trusted request identity/route/method/correlation/Idempotency-Key digest. It performs no duplicate or replay judgment and makes no database read.
timeAndReplay.postReceiptRule: After same-tuple receipt reserve-or-read and canonical hash equality, the module repository atomically compare-and-sets the marker jti, exp and marker digest into the reserved result_reference.hrm012Authority.authorityEvidence array. Different-hash 409 always precedes marker replay evaluation.
timeAndReplay.safeRetryRule: A terminal same-tuple same-hash receipt is returned unchanged without binding or consuming a new marker and without an Auth verification call. For a nonterminal same-tuple same-hash receipt, the same unexpired jti may retry. A different fresh jti may replace the current entry only by atomic receipt-version CAS when the prior entry is expired or has state UNVERIFIED, DENIED or TRANSIENT_UNAVAILABLE and no metadata, artifact, payload, mapping, run, cursor or business effect has occurred. A VERIFIED_ALLOWED entry is immutable and no fresh jti may replace it. Cross-tuple, different-hash, expired-current-use, CAS loss or any second terminal use denies.
timeAndReplay.boundedStorage: result_reference preserves all unrelated existing keys and reserves only hrm012Authority. authorityEvidence is an ordered array of at most two entries: the current full {jti, exp, markerSha256, state, boundAt, authDecisionRevision} and, only after replacement, one immediately previous redacted {jtiSha256, exp, state, replacedAt}. No raw marker or opaque challenge is stored. No new replay table is authorized.

signedOwnerReceiptEvidence.opaqueChallengeRule: The exact client header X-DWP-Step-Up-Challenge is treated as an opaque string and carried only as the nullable opaque_step_up_challenge_ref claim inside the Auth-signed marker. Auth does not validate it before controller entry and the Gateway cannot inspect or attest it. A missing value is signed as JSON null; missing or malformed opaque reference is therefore a post-receipt step-up denial, not a pre-controller denial.
signedOwnerReceiptEvidence.gatewayRule: Gateway removes every caller-supplied X-DWP-HRM012-Owner-Receipt-Authority, X-DWP-Step-Up-Challenge, X-DWP-Expected-Decision-Revision and X-DWP-Expected-Object-Version header before forwarding. It preserves the sole ordinary If-Match transport header and forwards only the single Auth-issued marker; it never reconstructs, re-signs or changes claims.
signedOwnerReceiptEvidence.trustRule: Only server-authenticated Auth evidence relayed unchanged by Gateway and verified by People may reach the controller. The marker proves only trusted identity, accepted app entitlement, exact route/method and enabled feature decision plus a sealed opaque challenge reference. It is never an allow decision and never proof of purpose, step-up, narrow capability, duty, population or field authority.
signedOwnerReceiptEvidence.replayRule: Missing, invalid, expired, wrong-audience, wrong-route, wrong-method, cross-tenant, cross-subject, wrong-feature or caller-forged evidence denies before receipt. Duplicate and replay judgments occur only after receipt/hash under the atomic rules above.
signedOwnerReceiptEvidence.defaultOffRule: Default OFF is evaluated before this evidence is issued. The evidence cannot be produced, accepted or used to bypass OFF, zero enrollment, inactive enrollment or missing activation.

trustedPostReceiptStepUpVerification.callerAllowlist: Only authenticated service identity dwp-people-server with exactly one X-DWP-Hris-Origin-Authority-Token may call this exact method/path. Gateway, Platform, browser, support identities and every other service are denied; generic product-surface and meeting tokens must be absent.
trustedPostReceiptStepUpVerification.canonicalBodyHashRule: payloadSha256 is lowercase SHA-256 of the canonicalized exact six-field PEP-HRM-015 command body, using the same canonical bytes frozen in receiptRequestHash. It is not a hash of the envelope, headers or marker.
trustedPostReceiptStepUpVerification.trustedEqualityRule: Auth derives the current trusted tenant/subject, contextKey, scopeRef, authorization decisionRevision and feature revision from current evidence and requires exact equality to the DTO. ProductSurfaceStepUpRouteResolver and the signed ProductSurfaceStepUpChallengeContract bind publicCommandPath exactly to /api/people/v1/hris/integrations/workforce-ingestions; the trusted People caller and owner-route check bind serviceCommandPath exactly to /v1/hris/integrations/workforce-ingestions. Neither path is silently translated or used in place of the other. The challenge also binds objectRef target, numeric If-Match version, raw Idempotency-Key and payloadSha256. Client or People cannot invent context, scope or revision.
trustedPostReceiptStepUpVerification.decisionOrder: Auth verifies the trusted People caller and exact closed DTO, re-evaluates the enabled feature plus canonical accepted app entitlement, then requires exact hcm.integration.workforce-ingestion.execute, HRIS_DUTY_INTEGRATION_EXECUTOR and fixed HRIS_INTEGRATION purpose, and only then validates target-bound HIGH STEPUP-MGMT-HIGH-V1 against objectRef, If-Match, raw Idempotency-Key and canonical payloadSha256. Unavailable, malformed, stale, missing or denied evidence fails closed.
trustedPostReceiptStepUpVerification.receiptPrecedence: People may call this endpoint only after the durable same-tuple receipt reserve-or-read and canonical request-hash comparison has succeeded. Same-tuple different-hash 409 is returned without an Auth call. Tests must prove zero Auth calls on schema failure and receipt hash conflict.
trustedPostReceiptStepUpVerification.allowedDecision: ALLOWED only; every other value or extra/missing field denies
trustedPostReceiptStepUpVerification.noMetadataRule: The endpoint neither receives nor returns connector, mapping, legal-entity, field-decision, artifact, payload, run or cursor data.

v57NormalChallengeCandidateException.rule: Only for this exact v57 route/profile, ProductSurfaceStepUpRouteResolver, ProductAuthorizationAuthorityAdapter and ProductSurfaceStepUpChallengeService may resolve an ELEVATED-only profile as a NORMAL-session challenge candidate so the user can obtain or refresh step-up evidence. Candidate resolution is not command authorization, does not return ALLOWED, does not bypass feature/app/capability/duty/purpose requirements and cannot populate owner HcmPepContext authority.
v57NormalChallengeCandidateException.finalDecision: The receipt-first verification endpoint re-evaluates current authority and requires ELEVATED plus fresh HIGH assurance before returning ALLOWED.
v57NormalChallengeCandidateException.isolation: Every other route/profile retains its current access-mode selection and challenge behavior byte-for-byte semantically; no generic ELEVATED-from-NORMAL fallback is allowed.

controllerAndOwnerOrderExactly: verify the signed OWNER_RECEIPT_AUTH_REQUIRED handoff evidence and parse the exact closed request body and exact allowed headers; reject unknown fields and forbidden authority inputs without receipt, Auth verification, object, artifact or payload access

reserve or read the durable receipt by exactly trusted tenant, on-behalf-of subject, originating action and Idempotency-Key; freeze the canonical request hash and immutable receipt authority metadata; same tuple plus different hash returns 409

if the same-hash receipt is terminal, return the immutable original receipt immediately without marker replay binding, new marker consumption or Auth call; otherwise atomically bind or safely replace marker evidence in result_reference.hrm012Authority by the sealed CAS rules

after the receipt and hash outcome is durable and marker replay CAS passes, call the exact trusted Auth verification endpoint; re-evaluate feature plus app first, exact hcm.integration.workforce-ingestion.execute plus HRIS_DUTY_INTEGRATION_EXECUTOR second, fixed HRIS_INTEGRATION purpose third and target-bound HIGH STEPUP-MGMT-HIGH-V1 last against objectRef, If-Match, raw Idempotency-Key and canonical body SHA-256; require its closed ALLOWED result
only after those decisions pass, resolve immutable trusted-tenant metadata for the exact objectRef and require resolved identity plus version to match objectRef, step-up target and If-Match
evaluate predicate.hcm-workforce-ingestion-scope.v1 over the resolved connector set and every derived legal entity; empty, stale, mixed-tenant, unknown or partial coverage denies
evaluate INTEGRATION_METADATA and REDACTED_PAYLOAD field decisions using the revisions frozen on the receipt
only after all prior stages pass may the owner fetch artifact or payload bytes, resolve a published mapping, create a run or item, advance a cursor or perform a business mutation
correctedReceiptFirstProtocol.stepUpFailureRule: For the exact HRM-012 ACTION, missing, weak, malformed, stale, wrong-target or wrong-version step-up is returned by the trusted post-receipt Auth verification call only after durable same-tuple receipt reserve-or-read and canonical hash comparison, and always before trusted metadata resolution, artifact or payload fetch, mapping lookup, run creation, cursor access or business mutation.
correctedReceiptFirstProtocol.legacyCapabilityRule: A request holding only legacy hcm.integration.execute may reach the receipt boundary only when every pre-controller check passes. It reserves or reads the same-tuple receipt and compares the hash, then fails the exact narrow capability decision before step-up validation and before metadata, artifact, payload, run, cursor or business access. Legacy authority is never accepted as fallback.
correctedReceiptFirstProtocol.readRouteRule: The PAGE and DATA routes retain their v1 read-only hcm.operations.people.view and workforce population/field projection semantics. Feature default-OFF applies before their controller or browser data call and availableActions remains empty.
